15: ## When to Use
16: 
17: - User wants to create an explainer or tutorial video
18: - User asks to "explain" something in video form
19: - User wants narrated content with AI-generated visuals
20: - User says "explainer video", "解说视频", "tutorial video"

22: ## When NOT to Use
23: 
24: - User wants audio-only content without visuals (use `/speech` or `/podcast`)
25: - User wants a podcast-style discussion (use `/podcast`)
26: - User wants to generate a standalone image (use `/image-gen`)
27: - User wants to read text aloud without video (use `/speech`)
28: 
29: ## Purpose
30: 
31: Generate explainer videos that combine a single narrator's voiceover with AI-generated visuals. Ideal for product introductions, concept explanations, and tutorials. Supports text-only script generation or full text + video output.
32: 
33: ## Hard Constraints
34: 
35: - Always read config following `shared/config-pattern.md` before any interaction
36: - Follow `shared/cli-patterns.md` for execution modes, error handling, and interaction patterns
37: - Always follow `shared/cli-authentication.md` for auth checks
38: - Never hardcode speaker IDs — always fetch from the speakers CLI when the user wants to change voice
39: - Never save files to `~/Downloads/` or `.listenhub/` — save artifacts to the current working directory with friendly topic-based names (see `shared/config-pattern.md` § Artifact Naming)
40: - Explainer uses exactly 1 speaker
41: - Mode must be `info` (for Info style) or `story` (for Story style) — never `slides` (use `/slides` skill instead)

48: ## Step -1: CLI Auth Check
49: 
50: Follow `shared/cli-authentication.md` § Auth Check. If the CLI is not installed or the user is not logged in, auto-install and auto-login — never ask the user to run commands manually.

56:   CMD_PREFIX="listenhub openapi storybook"
57: else
58:   CMD_PREFIX="listenhub explainer"
59: fi
60: ```
61: 
62: All subsequent CLI calls use `$CMD_PREFIX` instead of hardcoded `listenhub explainer`.
63: 
64: **Note:** The OpenAPI command is `storybook` (not `explainer`) — same backend, different naming.

66: ## Step 0: Config Setup
67: 
68: Follow `shared/config-pattern.md` Step 0 (Zero-Question Boot).

118: ## Interaction Flow
119: 
120: ### Step 1: Topic / Content
121: 
122: Free text input. Ask the user:
123: 
124: > What would you like to explain or introduce?
125: 
126: Accept: topic description, text content, or concept to explain.
127: 
128: ### Step 2: Language
129: 
130: If `config.language` is set, pre-fill and show in summary — skip this question.
131: Otherwise ask:
132: 
133: ```
134: Question: "What language?"
135: Options:
136:   - "Chinese (zh)" — Content in Mandarin Chinese
137:   - "English (en)" — Content in English
138:   - "Japanese (ja)" — Content in Japanese
139: ```
140: 
141: ### Step 3: Style
142: 
143: If `config.defaultStyle` is set, pre-fill and show in summary — skip this question.
144: Otherwise ask:
145: 
146: ```
147: Question: "What style of explainer?"
148: Options:
149:   - "Info" — Informational, factual presentation style
150:   - "Story" — Narrative, storytelling approach
151: ```
152: 
153: ### Step 4: Speaker Selection
154: 
155: Follow `shared/speaker-selection.md`:
156: - If `config.defaultSpeakers.{language}` is set → use saved speaker silently
157: - If not set → use **built-in default** from `shared/speaker-selection.md` for the language
158: - Show the speaker in the confirmation summary (Step 6) — user can change from there if desired
159: - Only show the full speaker list if the user explicitly asks to change voice
160: 
161: Speaker query: see `shared/cli-speakers.md` for listing and filtering speakers.
162: 
163: Only 1 speaker is supported for explainer videos.
164: 
165: ### Step 5: Output Type
166: 
167: ```
168: Question: "What output do you want?"
169: Options:
170:   - "Text script only" — Generate narration script, no video
171:   - "Text + Video" — Generate full explainer video with AI visuals
172: ```
173: 
174: ### Step 6: Confirm & Generate
175: 
176: Summarize all choices:
177: 
178: ```
179: Ready to generate explainer:
180: 
181:   Topic: {topic}
182:   Language: {language}
183:   Style: {info/story}
184:   Speaker: {speaker name}
185:   Output: {text only / text + video}
186: 
187:   Proceed?
188: ```
189: 
190: Wait for explicit confirmation before running any CLI command.
191: 
192: ## Workflow
193: 
194: Run the CLI command with `run_in_background: true` and `timeout: 660000`. The CLI blocks until generation completes and returns the final result as JSON:
195: 
196: ```bash
197: $CMD_PREFIX create \
198:   --query "{topic}" \
199:   --mode {info|story} \
200:   --lang {en|zh|ja} \
201:   --speaker "{name}" \
202:   --speaker-id "{id}" \
203:   --timeout 600 \
204:   --json
205: ```
206: 
207: If the command fails (non-zero exit), check stderr for error details. See `shared/cli-patterns.md` § Error Handling for exit codes and common errors.
208: 
209: **Optional flags** (add when applicable):
210: - `--source-url "{url}"` — if the user provided a reference URL
211: - `--skip-audio` — if text-only output (no video)
212: - `--image-size {2K|4K}` — image resolution (default: 2K)
213: - `--aspect-ratio {16:9|9:16|1:1}` — video aspect ratio (default: 16:9)
214: - `--style "{style}"` — visual style for AI-generated images
215: 
216: Tell the user the task is submitted. When notified of completion, **parse and present result**:
217: 
218:    Parse the CLI JSON output for key fields:
219:    ```bash
220:    EPISODE_ID=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.episodeId')
221:    AUDIO_URL=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.audioUrl // empty')
222:    VIDEO_URL=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.videoUrl // empty')
223:    CREDITS=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.credits // empty')
224:    ```
225: 
226:    Read `OUTPUT_MODE` from config. Follow `shared/output-mode.md` for behavior.
227: 
228:    **If text-only output**:
229: 
230:    **`inline` or `both`**: Present the script inline.
231: 
232:    Present:
233:    ```
234:    解说脚本已生成！
235: 
236:    「{title}」
237: 
238:    在线查看：https://listenhub.ai/app/explainer/{episodeId}
239:    ```
240: 
241:    **`download` or `both`**: Also save the script file. Generate a topic slug following `shared/config-pattern.md` § Artifact Naming.
242:    - Save as `{slug}-explainer.md` in cwd (dedup if exists)
243:    - Present the save path in addition to the above summary.
244: 
245:    **If text + video output**:
246: 
247:    **`inline` or `both`**: Display video URL and audio URL as clickable links.
248: 
249:    Present:
250:    ```
251:    解说视频已生成！
252: 
253:    视频链接：{videoUrl}
254:    音频链接：{audioUrl}
255:    消耗积分：{credits}
256:    ```
257: 
258:    **`download` or `both`**: Also save files. Generate a topic slug following `shared/config-pattern.md` § Artifact Naming.
259:    - Create `{slug}-explainer/` folder (dedup if exists)
260:    - Write `script.md` inside
261:    - Download audio:
262:      ```bash
263:      listenhub download "{audioUrl}" -o "{slug}-explainer/audio.mp3"
264:      ```
265:    - Present:
266:      ```
267:      已保存到当前目录：
268:        {slug}-explainer/
269:          script.md
270:          audio.mp3
271:      ```
272: 
273: ### After Successful Generation
274: 
275: Update config with the choices made this session:
276: 
277: ```bash
278: NEW_CONFIG=$(echo "$CONFIG" | jq \
279:   --arg lang "{language}" \
280:   --arg style "{info/story}" \
281:   --arg speakerId "{speakerId}" \
282:   '. + {"language": $lang, "defaultStyle": $style, "defaultSpeakers": (.defaultSpeakers + {($lang): [$speakerId]})}')
283: echo "$NEW_CONFIG" > "$CONFIG_PATH"
284: ```
285: 
286: **Estimated times**:
287: - Text script only: 2-3 minutes
288: - Text + Video: 5-10 minutes
